An '''asteroid field''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was here that the ''[[Far Orbit]]''{{'s}} [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] complement [[Battle of the Silent Blades|squared off]] with the [[Tarnished Blades|Silent Blades]].
